name: deckhand
description: Deckhand — the multi-AI toolbar for Claude Code. A band above the prompt with usage gauges, one-click model buttons, Sub5 parallel sub agents in git worktrees, read-only delegation to Codex, Cursor agent and agy, a plain-words recap, and a tabbed ⚙ settings pane; plus opt-in translation and web search by a delegate, background deploy/PR/CI watch, Claude↔Codex handoff, and attribution and polling guards. In 41 languages.
